{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Step 1: Filter out QC-failure rows (biomarker_baseline == -999)
df_filtered = df[df['biomarker_baseline'] != -999]

# Step 2: Deduplicate by patient_id, keeping the row with the highest sample_seq
# Sort by sample_seq descending, then drop duplicates on patient_id
df_dedup = df_filtered.sort_values('sample_seq', ascending=False).drop_duplicates(subset=['patient_id'], keep='first')

# Step 3: Compute the mean of biomarker_baseline
mean_baseline = df_dedup['biomarker_baseline'].mean()

# Print the number of patients after deduplication
print(f"Number of patients after deduplication: {len(df_dedup)}")
print(f"Mean baseline biomarker value (ng/mL) across all patients: {mean_baseline}")"}
